value.rationale: An exact all-matching, all-odd-projective-plane quantum-entanglement law is a natural interaction-informatics classification. A single omission raises entropy by one, whereas mutually noncrossing omissions beyond one reverse and can drive an unbounded q-1 loss in classical conic geometries. This identifies a parity-specific structural response inaccessible from the same-domain even-q theorem or general cut rank alone. It is not a narrow arbitrary numerical slice; no device advantage is implied.
